corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez vocative phrase 'ዕደው አኃዊነ' / 'ዕደ ብእሲ' (Acts 2:29 'ታበውሑኒሁ ዕደው አኃዊነ ንንግርክሙ ክሡተ በእንተ ዳዊት ርእሰ አበው'; here printed 'ዕደ↵ብእ'); 'ዕደ' was misread as 'እሰ'.
Wait: the word across L34-35 is 'አ↵ዝል ቅጽል የላትም' (corresponding to 'ዕዝል ቅጥል የላትም' in L36-37). In the image, the last character of L34 is clearly 'አ' ('አ↵ዝል'), misread as 'ቅ'.
The word wrapping across L34-L35 is 'አዝል' ('አዝል ቅጽል የላትም'), matching the parallel 'ዕዝል ቅጥል የላትም' in L36-L37; the glyph at the end of L34 is clearly 'አ', misread as 'ቅ'.
In traditional Andemta terminology, 'ውፁእ ፊል ነው' (an excluded/cast-out letter or element, glossing 'ሕፁፀ ይከውን') has 'ፊል' where the bottom right loop of 3rd-order 'ፊ' was misread as 'ፈ.ል'.
Ge'ez causative imperfect 'ወያሐፅፆሙ እመንግሥተ አቡሁ' (4th order 'ያ' in 'ወያሐፅፆሙ'), visually distinct in the image with the shorter right leg of 'ያ'.
